extraction.name: RoboFAC dataset
extraction.description: A large-scale and diverse dataset for question-answering on robot failure videos, comprising 9,440 erroneous manipulation trajectories and 78,623 QA pairs across 16 diverse tasks and 53 scenes in both simulation and real-world environments.
extraction.creator: Weifeng Lu, Minghao Ye, Zewei Ye, Ruihan Tao, Shuo Yang, Bo Zhao
extraction.citeAs: Lu, Weifeng; Ye, Minghao; Ye, Zewei; Tao, Ruihan; Yang, Shuo; Zhao, Bo. RoboFAC: A Comprehensive Framework for Robotic Failure Analysis and Correction. arXiv:2505.12224v3, 2025.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was constructed from both simulation and real-world robotic manipulation tasks. In simulation, data were collected for 14 robotic tasks in the ManiSkill environment, augmented with YCB Object Dataset objects and scenes from ReplicaCAD and AI2-THOR. For each custom task, an expert policy was defined by specifying target end-effector poses for each substage, and feasible paths and trajectories were generated using motion planning. Failure data were generated by replacing the original expert policy with a code snippet that generated an erroneous trajectory at a selected substage, causing task failure. During collection, each robotic failure video was recorded with a corresponding descriptive text including the failure substage, taxonomy, and detailed explanation; perturbed poses were also recorded for pose-perturbation failures. In the real world, data for 6 tasks were collected via teleoperation using the SO-100 robotic arm, with each video also accompanied by a textual description. Successful trajectories were also collected to prevent overfitting to failure patterns.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Experiments, Software Collection, Direct measurement, Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw data consist of robot manipulation videos and corresponding textual descriptions. Simulation raw data come from 14 tasks in ManiSkill, with objects from the YCB Object Dataset and scenes from ReplicaCAD and AI2-THOR. Real-world raw data come from 6 teleoperated tasks collected using the SO-100 robotic arm.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: To generate failure data, the original expert policy was replaced with a code snippet that generated an erroneous trajectory at a selected substage. For failures caused by perturbations in the end-effector pose, the perturbed pose was recorded.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Because motion planning occasionally failed and produced trajectories that did not align with the corresponding textual descriptions, the authors manually performed thorough data cleaning and retained approximately 75% of the collected simulation data.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The raw videos were annotated to construct video-based QA samples for eight question types covering task understanding, failure analysis, and failure correction. For each question type, five question templates were provided. For each sample, the reference answer was generated based on the textual description associated with the video. For task identification, task planning, failure detection, failure identification, and failure locating, answers were directly extracted from the textual description. For failure explanation, high-level correction, and low-level correction, both the video and its textual description were provided to GPT-4o to generate reference answers. All GPT-4o outputs were manually reviewed and corrected.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: To ensure annotation quality, all outputs from GPT-4o were manually reviewed and corrected.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The paper states that the framework enables more robust and transparent deployment of vision-language models in diverse and challenging robotic manipulation scenarios, and that the RoboFAC model can improve the success rate when integrated as an external critic in real-world VLA control tasks.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The paper notes that the current integration of the RoboFAC model into the VLA-controlled robotic system is not yet seamless. It also states that success rate remains subject to further enhancement, largely due to the VLA model's limited ability to follow complex natural language instructions. Additionally, the work applies the model exclusively to the VLA model, while more targeted correction strategies for hierarchical policies remain future work.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is used for training and evaluation of multimodal models for robotic failure video understanding, including task understanding, failure analysis, and failure correction. The authors construct a training set by randomly sampling 60K QA pairs from the simulated RoboFAC dataset, and use the remaining QA pairs for evaluation, including 10K simulated QA pairs and 8K real-world QA pairs. The dataset also serves as a benchmark for assessing multimodal models' capabilities in robotic failure video understanding.
